title: Yaadan Aundia Nay Akbar Beemar
body:
Yaadan aundia ney akbar beemar nu teriyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Mursal di soorat waleya mein takkdi raawan teriyan…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Sunndi haan roz azaana
tere naam di khatir mein
Veeran haan hazir mein
Quran qasida tera eh
Ay sab aazana teriyan…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Bhena nu hondey akbar
Barrey maarn bhirawan tey
Aitbaar nai saawan tey
Tennu wekhan dey layi jooniya
Mennu veeran aasan teriyan…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Mein roz khayalan dey wich
Tere shagan manowndi rayi
Sirr sehrey sajowndi rayi
Tere janjiyan wich howan veeran
Sab phuppiyan maawan teriyan…
